description: Get a wallet's balances: native coin (ETH, BNB, POL, AVAX, SOL) and tokens. Solana: every SPL token held. EVM: popular tokens on the chain plus any token addresses you pass. Also returns transactions sent and whether the address is a contract.

chain.description: Chain: ethereum, bsc, base, arbitrum, polygon, optimism, avalanche, solana

tokens.description: Optional extra EVM token addresses to include (max 20)

name: get_wallet_balances
